evidence.reason: claim_run_dir creates the record base and the new run directory but never fsyncs the base directory (or, when the base is newly created, its parent). A subsequent durable_write inside the run directory can persist the receipt and the run directory’s own entry, but it cannot persist the run directory’s entry in its parent. After a power loss, the host can remain held while the entire run directory and its recovery state are lost. Add an fsync of the base directory after creating the run directory, fsync any newly created parent entry, and fail before admission if either step fails.
